title: Calendar Travel-Time Overbook
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(travel_min) as travel_min, sum(duration_min) as meeting_min by calendar _time
| where travel_min>120 AND meeting_min>240
| sort - travel_min
description: Uses Calendar event metadata telemetry to monitor days where travel time piled on top of a heavy meeting load in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for schedules that are physically unrealistic, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Calendar event metadata data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily calendar table of meeting and travel minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers days where travel time piled on top of a heavy meeting load so you can spot schedules that are physically unrealistic before it becomes annoying.
